genius.notes: Reviewed October 7, 2026. OCC Corporate Decision 1385 names BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. as the current exclusive USD1 issuer and custodian. World Liberty Trust Company has preliminary conditional national trust charter approval only; it intends to assume issuance and reserve liabilities after establishment and cannot commence business before final approval. The OCC BitGo conversion record is effective December 12, 2025. Neither charter record supplies a GENIUS PPSI approval or PPSI application. Issuer-announced-intent and the announced federal-qualified-nonbank route are retained on the WLFI GENIUS-alignment disclosures and proposed uninsured national trust bank business model. The August 2026 KPMG examination, signed September 24, still names BitGo as issuer. Published terms distinguish eligible clients with redemption access from holders without an account. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located in the bounded regulator/issuer search. Proposed federal rules and the Treasury SCRC procedural rule do not establish an effective PPSI approval regime. The opened December 30, 2020 OFAC settlement concerns BitGo, Inc., a separately named non-custodial wallet company, and predates USD1. It does not establish an action against BitGo Bank & Trust or USD1. A search also surfaced a possible April 2021 Connecticut consent order naming predecessor BitGo Trust Company. The Connecticut index, order PDF and bulletin could not be reopened because DNS resolution failed in plain fetch and the uniquely named browser fallback. EnforcementStatus is omitted pending primary-source verification of that predecessor history; no warning or prohibition is inferred from a search result.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, or official PPSI application was located. The WLTC charter filing and conditional decision are existing-authority national trust charter actions. NYDFS lists BitGo New York Trust Company, LLC, a different entity, and its listing is not USD1 PPSI authorization. Search conclusions are bounded to the opened official and issuer corpus.
